purpose: Close residual claims from the supplied Austrian WHT summary without expanding the current public dividend/interest/royalty product scope.

items.secondary_source_point: Royalty income attributable to an Austrian PE is subject to assessment treatment with expenses and credit for withholding rather than ordinary final withholding character.
items.decision_rule: PE attribution must never synthesize 0% payment-date WHT. It changes whether withholding is creditable in Austrian assessment and whether expenses are considered in assessment.

items.secondary_source_point: Income from a typical silent partnership has a special Austrian withholding route and must not be treated as ordinary dividend or ordinary interest solely from its economic label.
items.decision_rule: If transaction facts indicate a typical silent-partnership participation, do not auto-classify the payment as ordinary dividend/interest; return out-of-current-scope/review until a dedicated statutory category is implemented.

items.secondary_source_point: Technical/commercial consulting can be a separate § 99 withholding category.
items.decision_rule: Technical-service percentages must never be extracted as royalty rates. A service payment outside the royalty definition remains outside the current three-income runtime scope.

items.secondary_source_point: Supervisory-board remuneration has its own Austrian withholding treatment.
items.decision_rule: Do not map supervisory-board remuneration to dividend, interest or royalty.

items.secondary_source_point: Austrian real-property disposals have a separate real-estate income tax regime, including a corporate 23% option/rate route from 2024.
items.decision_rule: Do not treat real-estate disposal proceeds as any current WHT income type.

items.secondary_source_point: Austria has no separate branch-profits/remittance tax in the supplied summary.
items.decision_rule: No runtime branch added; keep as scope documentation only. Absence of a branch-profits tax does not alter dividend/interest/royalty WHT classification.
